{{nihongo|'''Amefutotama-no-Mikoto Shrine'''|天太玉命神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

'''Amefutotamanomikoto Shrine''' (あめふとたまのみことじんじゃ<ref>[http://www.narashinsei.com/search/%E3%82%A2%E8%A1%8C/%E5%A4%A9%E5%A4%AA%E7%8E%89%E5%91%BD%E7%A5%9E%E7%A4%BE/ Amefutotamanomikoto Shrine] (Nara Prefecture Association of Shinto Shrines).</ref> / あめのふとたまのみことじんじゃ{{Sfn|Amefutotamanomikoto Shrine (Heibonsha)|1981}}) is a Shinto shrine located in Inbe-chō, Kashihara City, Nara Prefecture. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} ({{ill|Myōjin Taisha|Q9610964|qid=Q9610964}}), and under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=former shrine ranking}} it was classified as a {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}.

It is known as the clan shrine of the ancient {{ill|Inbe clan|Q8189229|qid=Q8189229}} (Imbe clan).

=== Enshrined deities ===
The shrine enshrines the following four deities<ref name="説明板">On-site explanatory plaque.</ref>:
:* '''{{ill|Futodama|Q11059539|qid=Q11059539|lt=Amefutotamanomikoto}}''' (also read Amenofutotamanomikoto)
:* '''{{ill|Ōmiya-no-Me|Q24865597|qid=Q24865597|lt=Oomiyanome-no-mikoto}}'''
:* '''{{ill|Ama-no-Iwato-wake no Kami|Q10940542|qid=Q10940542|lt=Toyoiwamado-no-mikoto}}'''
:* '''{{ill|Ama-no-Iwato-wake no Kami|Q10940542|qid=Q10940542|lt=Kushiiwamado-no-mikoto}}'''

In the ''{{ill|Engishiki|Q1342448|qid=Q1342448}}'' {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}} (compiled in {{ill|Enchō|Q1327274|qid=Q1327274}} 5 [{{ill|927|Q30470|qid=Q30470}}]), the shrine is listed as having four enshrined deities{{Sfn|Amefutotamanomikoto Shrine (Heibonsha)|1981}}. It appears there as “Tamadamamiko Shrine, four deities,” with one deity identified as Tamadama-no-mikoto, while the identities of the remaining three are unclear{{Sfn|Amefutotamanomikoto Shrine (Kami-gami)|2000}}. The ''Engishiki'' also records four deities in the section on the Myōjin Festival.

=== About the enshrined deities ===
The principal deity, {{ill|Futodama|Q11059539|qid=Q11059539|lt=Tamadama-no-mikoto (Futodama)}}, is known as the ancestral deity of the ancient {{ill|Inbe clan|Q8189229|qid=Q8189229}}. According to the ''{{ill|Kojiki|ace|Kojiki|ar|كوجيكي|az|Kociki|bcl|Kojiki|be|Кодзікі|bg|Коджики|ca|Kojiki|ckb|کۆجیکی|cs|Kodžiki|da|Kojiki|de|Kojiki|eo|Koĝiki|es|Kojiki|et|Kojiki|eu|Kojiki|fa|کوجیکی|fi|Kojiki|fr|Kojiki|gl|Kojiki|he|קוג'יקי|hi|कोजिकी|hr|Kojiki|hu|Kodzsiki|hy|Կոձիկի|id|Kojiki|it|Kojiki|ja|古事記|ka|კოძიკი|kk|Кодзики|kn|ಕೋಜಿಕಿ|ko|고사기|la|Kojiki|lt|Kodžiki|mk|Коџики|ml|കൊജികി|ms|Kojiki|my|ခိုဂျိခိ|nl|Kojiki|no|Kojiki|oc|Kojiki|pl|Kojiki|pt|Kojiki|ro|Kojiki|rsk|Кодїки|ru|Кодзики|sh|Kojiki|simple|Kojiki|sk|Kodžiki|sl|Kodžiki|sr|Коџики|sv|Kojiki|ta|கோஜிகி|th|โคจิกิ|tl|Kojiki|tr|Kojiki|uk|Кодзікі|vi|Cổ sự ký|zh|古事記|zh_classical|古事記|qid=Q813031}}'', ''{{ill|Nihon Shoki|Q813935|qid=Q813935}}'', and ''{{ill|Kogo Shūi|Q531555|qid=Q531555}}'', this deity performed sacred rites together with {{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|fr|Ama-no-Koyane-no-mikoto|it|Ame-no-Koyane|ja|天児屋命|mni|ꯑꯃꯦ-ꯅꯣ-ꯀꯣꯌꯅꯦ|pt|Ame-no-Koyane|ru|Амэ-но коянэ-но микото|simple|Ame-no-Koyane|zh|天兒屋命|qid=Q2564508}} (ancestral deity of the {{ill|Nakatomi clan|Q1198447|qid=Q1198447}}) during the concealment of {{ill|Amaterasu|Q455602|qid=Q455602}} in the {{ill|Amano-Iwato|Q3231835|qid=Q3231835}} cave, and later accompanied {{ill|Ninigi-no-Mikoto|Q1056017|qid=Q1056017}} during the {{ill|Tenson kōrin|Q1084733|qid=Q1084733}} as one of the five accompanying deities{{Sfn|Amefutotamanomikoto Shrine (Kami-gami)|2000}}.  

The Inbe clan, descended from Futodama-no-mikoto, shared responsibility for court rituals with the Nakatomi clan{{Sfn|Inbe clan (ancient clan)|2010}}{{Sfn|Imbe (Ancient Clan Encyclopedia)|2015}}. The shrine listed in the ''Engishiki'' as “Tamadama-no-mikoto Shrine” is therefore thought to have been the clan shrine of the Inbe{{Sfn|Amefutotamanomikoto Shrine (Kami-gami)|2000}}. The surrounding area, bearing the place name “Inbe,” is considered the clan’s original homeland{{Sfn|Amefutotamanomikoto Shrine (Kami-gami)|2000}}. However, the identification of this shrine with the “Tamadama-no-mikoto Shrine” of the ''Engishiki'' dates only from {{ill|Genroku|ar|فترة غنروكو|cs|Genroku|de|Genroku|es|Genroku|fa|گنروکو|fr|Ère Genroku|id|Genroku|it|Genroku|ja|元禄|ko|겐로쿠|pt|Genroku|ru|Гэнроку|simple|Genroku|sk|Genroku|sr|Генроку|sv|Genroku|tr|Genroku|zh|元祿|qid=Q1325001}} 10 ({{ill|1697|Q7702|qid=Q7702}}), when it was proposed by Matsushita Kenrin, and its earlier history remains unclear{{Sfn|Amefutotamanomikoto Shrine (Kami-gami)|2000}}.

As noted above, the ''Engishiki'' lists four enshrined deities but gives no details. The ''Gogun Jinjaki'' identifies them as Amefutotama-no-kami, Oomiyanome-no-kami, Tamadama-no-mikoto (possibly {{ill|Amatomi no Mikoto|Q24899653|qid=Q24899653}}), and Amehi-no-rime-no-mikoto, while Matsushita Kenrin’s ''Tamadama-no-mikoto Shaki'' identifies them as Amefutotamanomikoto, Oomiyanome-no-mikoto, Toyoiwamado-no-mikoto, and Kushiiwamado-no-mikoto; the latter identification is followed today{{Sfn|Tamadama-no-mikoto Shrine, four deities (Shikinaisha)|1982}}. The three deities Oomiyanome-no-mikoto, Toyoiwamado-no-mikoto, and Kushiiwamado-no-mikoto are positioned in the ''Kogo Shūi'' and ''{{ill|Kujiki|Q2716751|qid=Q2716751}}'' as offspring deities of Futodama-no-mikoto{{Sfn|Amefutotamanomikoto Shrine (Kami-gami)|2000}}.

As described below, a {{ill|Ruijū Sandai Kyaku|Q11665185|qid=Q11665185}} dated {{ill|Jōgan|Q1075635|qid=Q1075635}} 10 ({{ill|868|Q25061|qid=Q25061}}) in the ''{{ill|Ruijū Sandai Kyaku|Q11665185|qid=Q11665185}}'' places the shrine of “Amefutotama-no-kami,” together with the shrines of Usutaki-no-kami and Kayamabime-no-kami, among the descendants of {{ill|Asuka-ni-Imasu Shrine|Q11665959|qid=Q11665959}}.

=== History ===
==== Overview ===
The date of founding is unknown. As noted above, the area is thought to have been the homeland of the Inbe clan, and the shrine is presumed to have been established as their clan shrine.

In official histories, an entry records that in {{ill|Ten'an|Q1075611|qid=Q1075611}} 3 ({{ill|859|Q23897|qid=Q23897}}) the divine rank of “Tamadama-no-mikoto” was promoted to Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade{{Sfn|Amefutotamanomikoto Shrine (Heibonsha)|1981}}. A {{ill|Ruijū Sandai Kyaku|Q11665185|qid=Q11665185}} dated June 28, {{ill|Jōgan|Q1075635|qid=Q1075635}} 10 ({{ill|868|Q25061|qid=Q25061}}) in the ''Ruijū Sandai Kyaku'' lists the shrine of “Amefutotama-no-kami” as one of the four descendant shrines of Asuka-no-kami{{Sfn|Amefutotamanomikoto Shrine (Heibonsha)|1981}}.

In the ''Engishiki'' Jinmyōchō (compiled in {{ill|Enchō|Q1327274|qid=Q1327274}} 5 [{{ill|927|Q30470|qid=Q30470}}]), it is listed in {{ill|Yamato Province|be|Ямата (правінцыя)|ca|Província de Yamato|ckb|پارێزگای یەماتۆ|cs|Provincie Jamato|de|Provinz Yamato|el|Επαρχία Γιαμάτο|es|Provincia de Yamato|fa|ولایت یاماتو|fi|Yamaton provinssi|fr|Province de Yamato|gl|Provincia de Yamato|hak|Yamato-koet|id|Provinsi Yamato|it|Yamato (provincia)|ja|大和国|ko|야마토국|lt|Jamato žemė|nl|Yamato (provincie)|no|Yamato (provins)|pt|Província de Yamato|ro|Provincia Yamato|ru|Ямато (провинция)|simple|Yamato Province|sk|Jamato (provincia)|sr|Провинција Јамато|th|แคว้นยามาโตะ|tr|Yamato (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Ямато|ur|یاماتو صوبہ|zh|大和國|zh_min_nan|Yamato-kok|zh_yue|大和國|qid=Q907495}}{{ill|Takaichi District, Nara|Q1117901|qid=Q1117901}} as “Tamadama-no-mikoto Shrine, four deities, Myōjin Taisha,” and is recorded as receiving offerings at the imperial {{ill|Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|Q11516161|qid=Q11516161}} and {{ill|Niiname-no-Matsuri|Q11501518|qid=Q11501518}}{{Sfn|Amefutotamanomikoto Shrine (Heibonsha)|1981}}. It also appears in the ''Engishiki'' section on extraordinary festivals. However, as the Inbe clan declined during the {{ill|Nara period|af|Nara-tydperk|ar|فترة نارا|bcl|Panahon nin Nara|bg|Нара (период)|bn|নারা যুগ|ca|Període Nara|ckb|سەردەمی نارا|cs|Období Nara|de|Nara-Zeit|el|Περίοδος Νάρα|eo|Epoko de Nara|es|Período Nara|eu|Nara aroa|fa|دوره نارا|fi|Nara-kausi|fr|Époque de Nara|gl|Período Nara|he|תקופת נארה|hr|Nara (razdoblje)|hu|Nara-kor|id|Zaman Nara|it|Periodo Nara|ja|奈良時代|jv|Periodhe Nara|ko|나라 시대|lt|Nara laikotarpis|ml|നാറ കാലഘട്ടം|ms|Zaman Nara|nl|Naraperiode|nn|Naratida|no|Nara-perioden|oc|Periòde de Nara|pl|Nara (okres)|ps|نارا|pt|Período Nara|ro|Perioada Nara|ru|Период Нара|sh|Nara period|simple|Nara period|sk|Obdobie Nara|sl|Obdobje Nara|sr|Нара период|sv|Naraperioden|th|ยุคนาระ|tl|Panahong Nara|tok|tenpo pi kulupu lawa Nala|tr|Nara Dönemi|uk|Період Нара|ur|نارا دور|vi|Thời kỳ Nara|war|Panahon Nara|wuu|奈良时代|zh|奈良時代|zh_min_nan|Nara sî-tāi|zh_yue|奈良時代|qid=Q189178}} and {{ill|Heian period|Q193292|qid=Q193292}}, in contrast to the rise of the Nakatomi clan, the shrine is thought to have similarly fallen into decline{{Sfn|Amefutotamanomikoto Shrine (Kami-gami)|2000}}.

During the {{ill|Muromachi period|Q334845|qid=Q334845}}, a document dated {{ill|Kakitsu|Q1193238|qid=Q1193238}} 1 ({{ill|1441|Q6402|qid=Q6402}}), the “Kōfuku-ji Kanmuchi Chōsho,” records a shrine of “Tamadama-no-kami” in Inbe, Takaichi District, noting that it was affiliated with {{ill|Kōfuku-ji|Q1070863|qid=Q1070863}} and that its temple-shrine complex ({{ill|Jingū-ji|Q1074971|qid=Q1074971}}) was Renkō-ji{{Sfn|Amefutotamanomikoto Shrine (Heibonsha)|1981}}{{Sfn|Amefutotamanomikoto Shrine (Kami-gami)|2000}}.

In the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}}, the shrine was known as “Kasuga Shrine,” but in {{ill|Genroku|ar|فترة غنروكو|cs|Genroku|de|Genroku|es|Genroku|fa|گنروکو|fr|Ère Genroku|id|Genroku|it|Genroku|ja|元禄|ko|겐로쿠|pt|Genroku|ru|Гэнроку|simple|Genroku|sk|Genroku|sr|Генроку|sv|Genroku|tr|Genroku|zh|元祿|qid=Q1325001}} 10 ({{ill|1697|Q7702|qid=Q7702}}) it was identified by {{ill|Matsushita Kenrin|Q92923373|qid=Q92923373}} as the “Tamadama-no-mikoto Shrine” of the ''Engishiki''{{Sfn|Amefutotamanomikoto Shrine (Heibonsha)|1981}}.

=== Divine ranks ===
* {{ill|Ten'an|Q1075611|qid=Q1075611}} 3 ({{ill|859|Q23897|qid=Q23897}}) {{ill|January 27|Q2284|qid=Q2284}}: promoted from Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade to Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade (''{{ill|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|Q1052981|qid=Q1052981}}'') — recorded as “Tamadama-no-mikoto.”

=== Subsidiary shrines ===
* Tamayorihime-no-mikoto Shrine — Deity: {{ill|Tamayori-hime|Q56344982|qid=Q56344982|lt=Tamayorihime-no-mikoto}}<ref name="説明板"/>. Located to the right of the main hall.
* Kasuga Shrine — Deity: {{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|fr|Ama-no-Koyane-no-mikoto|it|Ame-no-Koyane|ja|天児屋命|mni|ꯑꯃꯦ-ꯅꯣ-ꯀꯣꯌꯅꯦ|pt|Ame-no-Koyane|ru|Амэ-но коянэ-но микото|simple|Ame-no-Koyane|zh|天兒屋命|qid=Q2564508|lt=Ame-no-Koyane-no-mikoto}}<ref name="説明板"/>. Located to the left of the main hall.
